### Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
```

### Read in the data

```{r}
oahu_solar <- st_read(here("data/oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))
```

### Map the solar data

```{r}
mapview(oahu_solar)
```

### Retrieve some census data

```{r}
oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(geography = "tract",
 variable = "B19013_001",
 state = "HI",
 county = "Honolulu",
 geometry = TRUE,
 year = 2022)
```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_median_household_income, zcol = "moe")
```

```{r}
ggplot(oahu_median_household_income, aes(x = moe, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
